work: Aerophile currently lists the Angkor Wat balloon among its balloons in service and documents the Apsara installation near the temple from 2003. Official editor searches found no Angkor Balloon or Apsara standalone or Park. The distinct Angkor Eye ferris wheel was inspected. A CC0 photograph showing the actual tethered balloon was visually checked, imported, and published with eight-language alt text, captions and credits. Eight public pages and the OG image binary returned HTTP 200 before the Facebook post was published.
qualification: Fixed tethered helium balloon near Angkor Wat, separately operated as an attraction beside a heritage site. It is not the Angkor Eye ferris wheel or a park ride.
